{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint analysis not fully specified",
      "quote": "The primary efficacy endpoint for this study is the ORR as determined by central review.",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "4.2.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The primary endpoint is defined but the statistical analysis section does not provide a detailed analysis method for ORR (e.g., how patients with missing data or not evaluable are handled, and the exact estimation method).",
      "fix": "Add a detailed statistical analysis for the primary endpoint, including handling of missing data and non-evaluable patients."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing estimand attributes for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "The primary efficacy endpoint for this study is the ORR as determined by central review.",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "4.2.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The estimand for the primary endpoint lacks explicit specification of the population (e.g., FAS), variable definition (e.g., how response is defined), intercurrent events (e.g., treatment discontinuation, death), and summary measure (e.g., proportion with 95% CI).",
      "fix": "Define the estimand attributes for the primary endpoint in the statistical section."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoints lack analysis methods",
      "quote": "The secondary endpoints are: Duration of response, PFS, OS, CR rate, Change in scores of patient-reported outcomes in the EORTC QLQ-C30 and the Skindex-16, AEs, Concentrations of cemiplimab in serum (at select sites), Anti-cemiplimab antibodies",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "4.2.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The statistical methods section does not provide specific analysis methods for each secondary endpoint (e.g., how DOR, PFS, OS will be estimated, how PROs will be analyzed, how safety data will be summarized).",
      "fix": "Add detailed statistical analysis methods for each secondary endpoint."
    },
    {
      "title": "Exploratory endpoints lack analysis methods",
      "quote": "The following exploratory analyses are planned: Associations between tumor non-synonymous mutational burden at baseline and efficacy of cemiplimab",
      "page": 35,
      "section": "4.2.3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The statistical section does not describe how exploratory endpoints will be analyzed (e.g., correlation methods, adjustment for multiplicity).",
      "fix": "Add analysis methods for exploratory endpoints."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing data handling not specified",
      "quote": "Non-evaluable outcome or missing data will be handled based on the data handling strategy.",
      "page": 85,
      "section": "10.4",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The statement is vague and does not specify the actual data handling strategy for missing data, which is critical for the primary endpoint.",
      "fix": "Specify the missing data handling strategy (e.g., multiple imputation, worst-case analysis) for each endpoint."
    },
    {
      "title": "Multiplicity not addressed",
      "quote": "For Group 1, 50 patients are required to provide at least 95% power to reject a null hypothesis of an ORR of 15% at a 2-sided significance level of 5% if the true ORR is 34%. For Group 2, 80 patients are required to provide at least 95% power to reject a null hypothesis of an ORR of 20% at a 2-sided significance level of 5% if the true ORR is 35%.",
      "page": 82,
      "section": "10.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The statistical section does not mention any adjustment for multiple testing across the two groups or across secondary endpoints.",
      "fix": "Add a section on multiplicity control for primary and secondary endpoints."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size inputs inconsistent with primary objective",
      "quote": "For Group 1, 50 patients are required to provide at least 95% power to reject a null hypothesis of an ORR of 15% at a 2-sided significance level of 5% if the true ORR is 34%.",
      "page": 82,
      "section": "10.1",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The sample size calculation for Group 1 uses a null ORR of 15% and alternative of 34%, but the primary objective does not specify these thresholds; the protocol should justify these assumptions and ensure they align with the study design.",
      "fix": "Clarify the basis for the null and alternative ORR values and ensure consistency with the primary objective."
    },
    {
      "title": "Interim analysis not fully described",
      "quote": "An interim analysis of Group 1 patients will be performed at the time of the primary analysis for Group 2.",
      "page": 82,
      "section": "10",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The interim analysis is mentioned but not described in detail (e.g., stopping rules, alpha spending, decision criteria).",
      "fix": "Add a detailed description of the interim analysis, including any planned hypothesis testing or futility/stopping rules."
    }
  ]
}
